name: Bluechip X
note: SpaceX and Tesla. Float-adjusted market-cap weighting, like the S&P 500 (and so Vanguard's VOO). Float shares = sharesOutstanding (fetched live from SEC EDGAR by `cik`) x listedFraction x iwf. listedFraction: the share of the company's stock in listed classes S&P counts. iwf: S&P's investable weight factor, the fraction of listed shares not held by officers, directors and other strategic holders. Both are estimates from proxy statements; check them yearly (after proxy season) or after a large insider change. pool: the stock's USDC pool on Aerodrome Slipstream, used by the rebalancer. TSLAc: the same values as BLUE's (contracts/basket/mag7.config.json); keep them in step. SPCXc: SpaceX (IPO June 2026). Only Class A is listed (Class B, 10 votes a share, is nearly all Elon Musk's), and its filings tag the cover-page share count only per class, so `coverClasses` reads Class A from the latest 10-Q or 10-K and listedFraction is 1. iwf 0.81: the June 2026 prospectus puts 18.7% of Class A after the IPO with executive officers and directors (Musk 11.3%, Antonio Gracias/Valor 6.7%). Recheck it after the first proxy statement and as lock-ups end.
